item.tib: mkha' 'gying rigs lnga'i tshe sgrub g.yung drung lu gu rgyud kyi gter phreng
item.coloph: mkha' 'gying rigs lnga'i tshe sgrub g.yung drung lu gu rgyud kyi gter phreng zhes bya ba / dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis lcags mo byi ba'i lor / zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu'i nyin dang [ra] khyung rdzong gi mdun du brtsams pa dge legs 'phel

item.coloph: gsang ba gsang chen ma rgyud rgyal ba rgyal (rgya) mtsho'i lha tshogs bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i nang nas/ mkha' 'gying rigs lnga'i tshe sgrub g.yung drung lu gu rgyud kyi gter phreng zhes bya ba/ dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis/ lcags mo bya'i lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu nyin dang ra khyung rdzong gi mdun du brtsams pa dge legs 'phel//
